text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while waiting for the train
on the station platform...
...It seems the time to say goodbye has finally come, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We met exactly one year ago.
The days I've spent with you
are an irreplaceable treasure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl acts like she's having a sorrowful farewell, but
there's no one around to be seen...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Look, it's the seasonal regional bento...!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Today is the final day of sales...
We won't see each other again until next season. So—!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, vendor!
Could I get twelve of those box lunches, please!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Let me fill this heart and stomach
to make up for all the months we couldn't meet...!!"
choice_data_list: You should focus on one bento box at a time.
You really should focus on finishing one boxed lunch at a time.
Let's eat as much as we want!

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"...The number of memories doesn't matter.
What's important is the 'heart'—is that what you're trying to say?"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Just one serving, please.
So that I can have a heart-to-heart with this little one.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*munch*... Thank you, simmered dish...
...*chew*... Goodbye, whitefish...!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I will devour every single grain of rice and sesame seed
without leaving a trace!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, gulp*... Urgh...
F-Fight on, stomach of mine...
For the sake of... saying goodbye to these little ones—!!
